name: Question 2
problem:
Let $V={R}_{2}[t],$ the vector space of all polynomials of degree at most $2$ with real coefficients. Given that the inner product on $V$ is defined as 

$$
⟨p(t),q(t)⟩=p(-1)q(-1)+p(0)q(0)+p(1)q(1),
$$

find the orthogonal projection of $p(t)=2{t}^{2}-2t$ onto the subspace spanned by $q(t)=2t.$

EXPLANATION

The orthogonal projection of p(t) onto Span{q(t)} is given by

projq(t)p(t)=⟨p(t),q(t)⟩⟨q(t),q(t)⟩q(t).

In our case, we have

⟨p(t),q(t)⟩=p(−1)q(−1)+p(0)q(0)+p(1)q(1)=(2t2−2t)|−1⋅(2t)|−1+(2t2−2t)|0⋅(2t)|0+(2t2−2t)|1⋅(2t)|1=4⋅(−2)+0⋅0+0⋅2=−8+0+0=−8,

and

⟨q(t),q(t)⟩=q(−1)q(−1)+q(0)q(0)+q(1)q(1)=(2t)|−1⋅(2t)|−1+(2t)|0⋅(2t)|0+(2t)|1⋅(2t)|1=(−2)⋅(−2)+0⋅0+2⋅2=4+0+4=8.

Therefore, the projection is

projq(t)p(t)=⟨p(t),q(t)⟩⟨q(t),q(t)⟩q(t)=−88⋅(2t)=−2t.
